sheet.name: Puppet King Edelhardt
sheet.footprint: 2x2, rear = the two cells behind (R R, Blindspot)

traits.name: Welcome to My Castle!
traits.text:
Start of Clash: Perform The King Says: Come to Me Trait Attack (this does not count as an AI activation).
Additional Setup: Draw 2 Grave Mortis cards and place Loose String Terrain tiles on designated spaces. If you draw the same space twice, repeat the draw. If one of those spaces is occupied, place the Loose String Terrain tile on the closest empty space instead.

traits.name: Five Fingers
traits.text:
Puppet King Edelhardt cannot be involuntarily moved and turned.
When you wound one of the Five Fingers BP cards, immediately:
1st Finger: Flip one chosen Fallen Knight to Column Terrain tile.
2nd Finger: Flip two chosen Fallen Knights to Column Terrain tiles.
3rd Finger: Place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack.
4th Finger: Place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack.
5th Finger: Place a Generic Double Wound card on the Wound Stack.

traits.name: Shockwave
traits.text: Shockwave: Each Knight on the Clash Board loses -X [V] and suffers Knockback X, where X is 4 + the King's Level–the number of spaces between the Knight and the King. Treat this effect as a Wave Attack effect (you may block it with Obstacles).

traits.name: Dark Fog
traits.text: When you attack, lose -1 Precision for every space between you and the Target.

traits.name: Fallen Knight Army
traits.text:
! Fallen Knights move only in a straight line from the lowest numbered column to the highest numbered column.
End of your turn: Move the Fallen Knight that's in the same row as you 5 spaces. If there are no Fallen Knights in that row, move the furthest Fallen Knight in a chosen adjacent row instead. If you're on the VP, move any 1 Fallen Knight instead. Then, if no Fallen Knight was moved, Spawn a new Fallen Knight in the lowest numbered column in your row.
Fallen Knights destroy Column Terrain tiles they move through.
When you would place or move a Fallen Knight into Zone 1 around the King or the last column of the Clash Board (column 14), immediately remove that Fallen Knight from the Clash Board and the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Level 3+: 2 Armor [Armor] tokens instead. When the King gains the 5th Armor [Armor] token, discard all Armor [Armor] tokens and each Knight suffers Bane 5.
Treat Fallen Knights as Mobs that never activate. All Fallen Knights are represented by a single Trait BP card.
Each time a Fallen Knight is dealt a Wound, place a Generic token on its Trait BP card instead of Escalating. When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 2 or more Generic tokens on that card, discard all Generic tokens and place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack, then Escalate 1.

traits.name: Obedient Knights
traits.text: If you wound a King BP other than one of the Five Fingers and you're not on the VP, immediately place a Fallen Knight on an adjacent space closest to the King. If you deal a Wound from the VP, after you finish resolving your Attack, perform Signature.

traits.name: Unstoppable Force
traits.text: When a Fallen Knight is about to move through or onto a Knight's space, that Knight suffers Forced Vault and Knockdown, then the Fallen Knight continues its movement.

traits.name: On Command
traits.text: When you're about to draw an AI, look at the top 2 AI cards and perform the higher Level one. If both cards are the same Level, perform the one that is a Command Attack. If neither is a Command Attack, perform Routine instead.

vp.name: The Seat of Power
vp.text:
When you move onto the Loose String Terrain tile, immediately climb the VP (see the Loose String Terrain card).
[Move action] If you're in the Blindspot, climb the VP.
While on the VP, you gain either Precise or Heartseeker, ignore Armor [Armor] tokens and have +1 [Power]. Ignore normal Responses, and resolve these instead:
WOUND: Gain the Subjugated Condition card. Move to any space in front and in Zone 1 of the King.
FAIL: Shockwave. Displace to any space in front and adjacent to the King.

unclear: Level bar: first blue-bar number read as Escalations, then +AT, +[die], +[V]

ai.name: Dismissive Flick
effects: For each hit lose -3 [V]. Knockback 6 and Knockdown. [Peril].

ai.name: Dragged by the Ear
effects: For each hit lose -3 [V] and gain +1 [H]. [Peril]. If you're on the VP, Displace.

ai.name: The King Commands: Bow Down!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Disobey: Gain the Subjugated Condition card. For each hit lose -2 [V]. [Peril].
ai.after: If all Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

ai.name: The King Commands: Begone!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Disobey: For each hit lose -2 [V]. Two or more hits, gain the Subjugated Condition card. [Peril].
ai.after: If all Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

ai.name: The King Commands: Begone!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Disobey: For each hit lose -2 [V]. Two or more hits, gain the Subjugated Condition card. [Peril].
ai.after: If all Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

ai.name: Eye Poke
ai.after: Exhaust a Weapon [Gear] card or discard a Helm [Gear] card.

ai.name: The King Commands: Obey Me!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Obey: Exhaust all your Gear [Gear] cards.
Disobey: For each hit lose -2 [V]. Bane 1. [Peril]. Gain the Subjugated Condition card.
ai.after: If at least 2 Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. All Knights in Zone 2 suffer Knockdown.

ai.name: The King Commands: Get Out of My Sight!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Disobey: For each hit lose -3 [V]. Gain the Subjugated Condition card. [Peril].
ai.after: If at least 2 Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

ai.name: The King Commands: Entertain Me!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Obey: Move up to your Speed to have another closest Knight in effective range of your Weapon. Perform a Power Roll as if you hit with all your Attack dice. That Knight loses [V] equal to Total Power.
Disobey: For each hit lose -3 [V]. Bane 2. [Peril].
ai.after: If all Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. All Targets gain the Subjugated Condition card.

ai.name: Shadow Punch
effects: Knockback X+4, where X is the number of hits.

ai.name: Crushing Burden
effects: Knockdown. All other Knights in Zone 2 around the Target suffer Discard, Restrain, and Knockdown.
ai.after: Gain a temporary negative Speed token.

ai.name: The King Commands: Yield!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Obey: Restrain all cards from your Hand and Cooldown area.
Disobey: For each hit lose -2 [V]. Bane 3. [Peril].
ai.after: If at least 2 Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. All Targets gain the Courage Condition card.

ai.name: The King Commands: Get Away From Me!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
ai.after: If at least 1 Target Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

ai.name: The King Commands: Lay Down Your Arms!
ai.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Obey: Exhaust all your Gear [Gear] cards.
Disobey: For each hit lose -3 [V] and Bane 1. [Peril].
ai.after: If at least 2 Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

signature.name: String Pull
signature.text: Two Fallen Knights closest to the left Board Edge move 3 spaces. If there is a tie, prioritize the Fallen Knights furthest from the King.

routine.name: It's Time to Pay!
routine.text: Each Knight loses -8 [V]. The King gains 2 Armor [Armor] tokens.

traitCards.name: The King Commands: Come to Me
traitCards.pre: NO KNIGHT IN ZONE: Perform Signature instead
effects: Obey: Move 4 spaces toward the King in a straight line. Gain the Subjugated Condition card.
traitCards.after: AFTER FINAL ATTACK: If all Targets Obeyed, the King gains 1 Armor [Armor] token. Shockwave.

traitCards.name: Fallen Knight
traitCards.header: Obstacle. Destructible. Odd Spawn. Fallen Knights have the same [To Hit] as the Puppet King.
traitCards.top: OVERCOME 3+: Power 1 · OVERPOWER 3+: Remove this Fallen Knight from the Clash Board
traitCards.wound: Discard the Subjugated Condition card. Flip this Fallen Knight to Column Terrain tile.
traitCards.critical: Discard all your Mind Condition cards. Flip this Fallen Knight to Column Terrain tile and place a Loose String Terrain tile adjacent to it. You may move up to 2 spaces and perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.instinct: Shockwave. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.critical: Leave additional 2 Opening and/or Break tokens.

bp.name: Five Fingers: The Little Finger
bp.wound: Shockwave. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.critical: You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Panzerthrone
bp.wound: Remove the Column Terrain tile closest to the King.

bp.name: Chaos Ladder
bp.top: OVERCOME 4+: Power 1 or discard 1 Armor [Armor] token
bp.wound: You may immediately climb the VP.
bp.critical: You may perform a Bonus Attack with Auto-break 2!

bp.name: Five Fingers: The Middle Finger
bp.wound: Knockback 4. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.critical: You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Five Fingers: The Index Finger
bp.wound: Shockwave. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.fail: Lose -3 [V]. Gain a temporary negative Precision token.
bp.critical: Gain +1 Precision until the end of Clash. You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Shield of the Fallen
bp.top: OVERCOME 5+: Power 1 or discard 1 Armor [Armor] token

bp.name: Shadowy Influence
bp.top: OVERCOME 4+: Power 1 or discard 1 Armor [Armor] token
bp.wound: Remove the Column Terrain tile closest to the King.
bp.critical: Until the end of Clash, Fallen Knights' movement during Signature is reduced by 2.

bp.name: Heart of the Throne
bp.top: OVERCOME 4+: Power 1 or discard 1 Armor [Armor] token
bp.wound: Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space. Armor-piercing 1.
bp.fail: Draw and perform an AI card.
bp.critical: You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Fluchaura

bp.name: Hoary Codger
bp.instinct: Draw and perform an AI card.

bp.name: Five Fingers: Hidden Finger

bp.instinct: Perform Signature. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.critical: Deal an additional Single Wound. You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Five Fingers: The Thumb
bp.top: OVERCOME 4+: Power 3 or discard 3 Armor [Armor] tokens
bp.wound: Shockwave. Place a Loose String Terrain tile on any empty space outside Zone 2 around the King.
bp.fail: Draw and perform an AI card against the Attacker.

bp.name: Riesenmörder Sword
bp.top: OVERCOME 3+: Power 1 or discard 1 Armor [Armor] token
bp.wound: Draw and perform an AI card.
bp.fail: Choke 3. Gain the Panicked Condition card.
bp.critical: Disable the Shockwave Trait. Immediately see 2329.

notes: "The King Commands: Begone!" appears twice among the AI 1 cards (6 AI 1 cards in total)
The Trait Attack is titled "The King Commands: Come to Me" on the card and "The King Says: Come to Me" on the Monster Sheet
Six BP cards are named Five Fingers (Ring, Little, Middle, Index, Hidden Finger, Thumb) while the Trait lists five results — which finger counts as which needs the rules reference
